title: Crunchy Herb and Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and crunchy side dish made with fragrant herbs, crisp vegetables, and a hint of polish flair.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the grated carrots and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked Polish sausage and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute.
Add the uncooked rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with vegetables.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
